Commentary.Commentary: That's it from us today. Hope you enjoyed our coverage. The action now shifts to Centurion for the 5th ODI. A match where Sri Lanka would be looking to end the tour with a win, while South Africa will eye the numero uno spot in the ODI rankings should they prevail victorious. Who will come out on top? Join us on February 10th at 1330 local (1130 GMT) to find out. Cheers!

MAN OF THE MATCH, FAF DU PLESSIS feels he was in good nick so he wanted to score big. Also admits that de Kock took pressure off him initially. He thinks there was something in the wicket for the bowlers and mentions that it was important to get yourselves in and then go for the big hits. He reveals that picking up singles is key to his batting style, also says he believes not accumulating dots. He admits that he didn't think about his double century at all. He also says that he should've put his wicket ball away, but is happy with his effort today.

AB DE VILLIERS is elated with the batting efforts. Credits Faf du Plessis for the way he constructed his innings. Adds that the wicket got slower in the later part of the game but praises Tharanga for the way he came out with the bat. Further says they were lucky as the bowlers didn't panic and picked up the wickets at the right time. Informs they wanted to delay Rabada's spell and is happy that it sort of worked for them. Ends by saying it is always tricky to change the combination but it has paid off and is proud of the performance put in by his team today.

UPUL THARANGA is happy with the way his team played today. Keeps on praising their batting efforts in this game but unfortunately is disappointed not to get over the line. Credits du Plesssis and de Villiers for the way they batted in the middle. Has no complaints regarding the wicket as he feels it was a good one for batting. Hopes that they can put up anther good performance and register a victory in the final game.

Having said that, it was a good performance from this Sri Lankan side to come this close in a tough chase. Talking about South Africa, their bowlers kept their nerves despite the visitors' brilliant start. It was Wayne Parnell who made the difference really. He removed Mendis and Tharanga in successive overs to break the back of the Sri Lankan chase. Pretorius and Rabada kept the visitors in check as well. The spin duo of Shamsi and Tahir proved to be expensive tonight. Stay tuned for the presentation...

South Africa were energized with the first breakthrough but the partnership of Tharanga and Kusal Mendis was flowering as they stitched together a 64-run stand off 67 balls. But as soon as Mendis fell, a flurry of wickets followed him and since then the visitors were never quite in the chase despite Tharanga's belligerent ton, albeit in a losing cause. Youngster Sandun Weerakkody did step up - scoring his maiden fifty - but it was a tad too late and he wasn't getting the expected support from the other end.

One will, rightfully, wonder whether it was Sanath Jayasuriya who gave the mid innings talk in the Sri Lankan dressing room.  The way Upul Tharanga and Niroshan Dickwella started, it definitely felt like that was the case. Both the opening batsmen started explosively scoring 100 off the first 10 overs. The game seemed to slip out of the hosts' control before Dwaine Pretorius, the 3rd ODI hero, put brakes on the onslaught forcing Dickwella to take the long walk back to the pavilion.

OUT! Wayne Parnell wraps it up, a 4-fer for him and boy, he is absolutely pumped up! He rolls his fingers on the ball and Lakshan Sandakan is completely deceived by it. He tries to go for a hoick across the line but misses and the ball goes on to hit the top part of the off stump. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 40 RUNS AND LEAD THE SERIES 4-0!
Comes from over the wicket and slants it away from the batsman, Kumara once again plays inside the line and is beaten all ends. A maiden over from Rabada!
Gets behind the line to this length ball and defends it down gently.
Fires in a yorker on the stumps, Kumara does well to keep it at bay.
Outside off, it's left alone this time.
Hits the deck hard, LK sits under the bumper.
Length delivery outside off, Lahiru plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Slower one on the pads, Kumara clips it towards the leg side for a single.
Driven through sweeper cover for a single.
Lakshan Sandakan arrives at the crease.

OUT! Straight to the man! Fuller in length and outside off, Lahiru Madushanka makes room to chip it over cover but has not got enough on it. Spoons a simple catch to Dwaine Pretorius who makes no mistake.
Third miss in a row! Short and slanting across again, LM swings and misses.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
A length ball outside off, Madushanka looks to go after it but fails to get any bat on it.
Lahiru Kumara comes out to bat.

OUT! Whattey catch, de Kock! He's pulled off a stunner yet again! Parnell bowls a back of a length ball outside off, Sachith Pathirana tries to use all the pace that the ball had with a ramp shot but fails to get enough elevation. Gets a top edge and de Kock behind the stumps times his leap to perfection to grab a one-handed stunner. He then gets up in some swag. South Africa just 2 wickets away now from a victory!
Wide! Slips it down the leg side, SP misses his flick.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
FOUR! A low full toss on the stumps, Madushanka crouches low and sends it packing over the extra cover for a one bounce boundary.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Lahiru ducks under it.
Leg bye! Angles it on the pads, the batsman misses the flick as the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Good length ball outside off, punched toward sweeper cover for a single.
Dwaine Pretorius comes back into the attack.
Lahiru Madushanka comes out to bat.

OUT! Top edge and Tahir gets another one! A good catch from Parnell as well! A loopy full toss around middle and off, Sandun Weerakkody once again looks to play the reverse sweep but this time gets a big top edge towards the off side. Wayne Parnell comes in from point and takes a good catch and tumbles after it but does well to hold on to it. That should be the final nail in the coffin. Tahir ends with figures of 10-0-76-2!
Quicker one around middle and leg, Sandun looks to whip it through the leg side but misses as the ball goes through his legs.

FOUR! Weerakkody isn't done yet! Loopy ball around middle and leg, Weerakkody once again opts for the reverse sweep. This time he makes a good connection as he beats Parnell's dive at backward point and finds the fence again.
FOUR! A googly but still goes to the rope! Weerakkody brings out the reverse sweep. Not off the middle of the bat but it races down to the third man fence for a much-needed boundary.

Loopy ball around off, the batsman waits for it as he pushes it towards the off side for a single. de Villiers comes running in and throws the ball towards the skipper in one motion. He seems to have hurt his wrist as he is ringing his right hand.
Sachith Pathirana is the next man in.

OUT! The decision stays as it is! A loopy full toss around middle, Nuwan Kulasekara winds up for a whip by shuffling across but misses the line and is rapped on the pads. A loud appeal from the leggie and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. The batsman takes the review but it's a waste one. They check for the no ball which is fine and then the HawkEye shows it is pitched in line and would have gone on to hit the timber. First one of the night for Tahir, SL still need 60 off 25 balls!
Kulasekara is adjudged LBW but the batsman has taken a review. Is there an inside edge?
Very full and fired outside off, SW looks to jam it out but fails to get any bat on it. There was some sound but it was probably off the bat hitting the ground.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Nuwan Kulasekara is the new man in!

OUT! A wicket against the run of play! Rabada dishes out a length ball on middle, Gunaratne looks to pull but doesn't get enough on it and as a result he ends up spooning a simple catch to Hashim Amla at short mid-wicket. End of a 79-run stand! 61 needed from 38 balls!
Sandun Weerakkody brings up his maiden ODI fifty.

FIFTY UP FOR THE YOUNGSTER! A length ball on middle, tucked towards square leg for a single. Gunaratne raises his bat to acknowledge the cheer from his mates. But as the commentator said, the job is not done yet. Can he take his team through?
Good length ball around off, Gunaratne looks to chip it over cover but doesn't get enough meat on it. The ball falls in the safe zone and they take a single.

SIX! Gunaratne welcomes Kagiso back into the attack! A length ball around middle, AG swivels a touch as he looks to pull it away on the leg side. Has enough legs as the ball goes over the fine leg fence for a maximum.
Kagiso Rabada is back into the attack!
Quicker one around middle and leg, tucked towards the leg side for a single. 11 from the over! 69 needed from 42 balls!
A googly around off, the batsman looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover for a single.
Change of bat for Sandun Weerakkody.
Gets back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Reverse sweep! Tossed up outside off, AG gets early into the position and reverse sweeps it over short third man for another boundary.
Around off, pushed towards point. Asela looks for a single but won't get it.
FOUR! A loopy full toss and it's put away! Gunaratne gets down and across to bring out the sweep shot. Hits it neatly as the ball races away through square leg for a boundary.
Imran Tahir is called back into the attack!
Fuller delivery, outside off, Weerakkody knocks it back to Parnell.
Gunaratne steers it to third man and runs one.
Weerakkody pulls it in front of square for a single.
SIX! Short delivery, Weerakkody smashes it over the mid-wicket fence. Much needed boundary for the Lankans. The runs had dried up after de Silva's wicket.
Gunaratne works it around for a single through square leg.
Gunaratne comes down the ground and hits it straight to mid-wicket.
50-run stand between Weerakkody and Gunaratne!
FOUR! Tossed up delivery, on middle, Weerakkody goes for a slog but bottom edges it towards long leg. Rabada dives to but fails to stop it.
Floated delivery, outside off, Weerakkody comes down the track and drills towards the cover region.
Weerakkody drives it to covers.

Tossed up delivery, on the sticks, Gunaratne looks to sweep but only gets an inside edge onto his stumps as it goes towards square leg. Shamsi thinks he's lbw and appeals, the umpire turns it down. But it wasn't as there was a clear edge.

Flight on offer, Weerakkody comes down the track, looking to drive it over covers, and mistimes it towards third man. Tahir makes a one hand stop and saves a certain boundary for his team. One run added to the total.
Floated delivery, Gunaratne pushes it towards covers and runs one.
Powerplay 3 signalled!
Length ball, outside off, Gunaratne steers it down to third man for a single.
DROPPED! Parnell digs it short, Weerakkody looks to pull and heaves it high up in the air near long leg. Shamsi looks good to grab but in the end messes it up. Puts down an easy catch. Single taken!
Shortish delivery, outside off, Gunaratne dabs it down to third man and runs one.
Back of a length again, around off, Weerakkody pulls it without any control to mid on and runs one.
Short of a length delivery, Gunaratne works it around to pick up another single.
Length delivery, outside off, Weerakkody looks to punch but manages to get an inside edge as the ball rolls to deep square leg for a single.
Wayne Parnell comes back into the attack.
Pushes it quicker through the air around off, Gunaratne goes back to defend but the ball just beats the inside edge and de Kock behind the stumps fails to collect it.
AG has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Falls safe! Drops it short on off, SW looks to pull but gets no timing behind it. It falls way short of the man at long on as they pick up a single.
FOUR! Tossed up around off, Sandun Weerakkody clears his front leg and flicks it through mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary.

A shout for a catch, not given! Loopy ball around off, Weerakkody looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and de Kock behind the stumps collects it. The bowler and the keeper go up in an appeal but it's turned down by the umpire. Replays show there was no part of the wood involved.
Floated ball around middle and leg, flicked off the pads towards short fine leg for a quick single.
Good length ball around off, Weerakkody drags it towards deep square leg where Tahir cuts it off. A couple taken.
Asela drives it towards long off for a single.
Fuller on off, the batsman comes down the track and knocks it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Put away! Good length ball on middle, comes up at a nice height too. Weerakkody pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Angles it in on the body, pulled though square leg for a single.
250 up for Sri Lanka! Shortish and outside off, Asela slaps it past point and comes back for a couple.
Dwaine Pretorius is back on!
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fligted ball around off, Gunaratne drives it towards the covers where Behardien dives to stop it. He parries it but the batsmen doesn't run.
Floated full ball around off, Sandun comes down the track and drives it towards long off for a single.
Just missed the off pole! Loops it up around off, Sandun gets down to fetch it from outside off but misses. Can consider himself lucky as the ball just whizzes past the off pole.
Short and outside off, Weerakkody looks to cut it away by reaching out that one but the ball turns away and he gets beaten.
Tossed up around middle and leg, worked towards square leg for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full delivery, angling down the leg side, Gunaratne tickles it fine as de Kock goes for a diving catch but the ball falls in front of him.
Gunaratne looks to attempt the same shot, but inside edges it towards keeper.
Gunaratne dabs it to third man for a couple.
Weerakkody nudges it to backward square leg for a single. Tahir has a wild throw, which Faf du Plessis grabs it near silly mid off region.
Wide! A bouncer down the leg side, it goes well over the head of the batsman.

DROPPED! FOUR! Back of a length delivery, Weerakkody pulls it towards deep square leg and it's a howler from Tahir, who is positioned there. Misses an easy opportunity, not only that he gives away four extra runs as wekk. It won't please Rabada at all.
Gunratane defends well under his eye line.

Run out chance! Weerakkody cuts it off the back foot to point and sets off immediately. Parnell, too, throws it back to de Kock instantly, however the glovesman fails to collect it, giving away a run out opportunity. A risky single taken.
Weerakkody goes for the sweep, but misses, his front foot too slips in the process.
FOUR! Floated delivery, Weerakkody comes down the track lofts it over mid on for a boundary. A risky shot, but it has paid dividends.
Tossed up delivery, Weerakkody defends it.
Short delivery, Weerakkody mistimes his pull to mid on.
Tabraiz Shamsi returns!
FOUR! Gets off the mark in style. Flicks it to to deep mid-wicket for a boundary, the mid on fielder gave it a chase but was beaten by the ball easily.
Asela Gunaratne is the new man in, replacing de Silva!

Drinks are on the field! South Africa have made a roaring comeback here! It was Wayne Parnell who got them the breakthroughs. Is the collapse on the cards? Let's see how the final passage of play pans out.

OUT! A full toss from Rabada which was dipping. De Silva wants to flick it but misses it completely. Gets rapped on the pads and nearly loses his balance in the process. Rabada appeals and the umpire signals him out in a flash. However, replays show it was missing the leg stump. The batsman should've used a review there.
Short delivery, Weerakkody pulls it to backward square leg for a single.
Full ball, outside off, Weerakkody drives it to covers.

Length ball, outside off, de Silva wants to dab it to third man but gets a bottom edge. Weerakkody urges him to come for a single and they steal it. It was a risk though, as replay suggested the southpaw would have been out at the striker's end. Rabada runs in from that position and kicks it just away from the stumps.
Weerakkody looks to pull it through mid-wicket, doesn't quite get the connection. However, he picks up a single to the same area.
De Silva gets an outside edge towards third man.
Half chance. Weerakkody looks to slog sweep it over deep mid-wicket, but mistimes it towards short third man. Parnell dives, but it falls just in front of him. Single taken!
Weerakkody defends it off the front foot.
De Silva works it around down the leg side for a single.
Short delivery, Weerakkody lofts it towards long on, de Kock shouts ecstatically but it was well away from the mid-wicket fielder. One run added to the total.
Flight on offer, Weerakkody wants to sweep it, but gets beaten on the turn.
Short delivery, Weerakkody wants to pull, but finds the inside edge as the ball rolls to fine leg. One run added to the total.
Full ball, outside off, Weerakkody drives it to covers for no run.
Risky! Rabada digs it short, Weerakkody wants to pull it but decides not to at the very last moment. He almost fell on the stumps, but did well to control his balance.
Weerakkody defends it from the crease.
Slightly outside off, de Silva dabs it down to third man for a single.
Length delivery, Weerakkody wants to pull, but was late into it and almost holes out near mid on, but it lands safely. Single taken!
Kagiso Rabada comes back into the attack.
De Silva punches it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Floated delivery, around off, De Silva leans forward and respectfully defends it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full toss, Weerakkody just punches it to long on and runs one.
Floated delivery, outside off, Weerakkody moves across looking to sweep but misses it in the end.
Tossed up  delivery, around off, de Silva knocks it down through mid on for a single.
Fuller and angling in, worked away towards mid on for a single. Superb over once again from Parnell, a big wicket and just a single from it!
Shortish outside off, tapped towards the man at backward point.
Fuller in length delivery on off, de Silva drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
De Silva stands tall and defends it with a straight bat.
Dhananjaya de Silva arrives at the crease.

OUT! Straight to the fielder! Parnell scalps another one! Back of a length ball outside off, Upul Tharanga looks to cut it away on the off side but ends up hitting it straight to JP Duminy at backward point who leaps a touch and gobbles it near his eye line. Tharanga trudges back but not before playing a good knock. Can the Saffas capitalize on it?
Tharanga reads the wrong 'un as he taps it towards the cover fielder for a single. 10 from it!

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! That's stand and deliver stuff from Tharanga! Sees the flight around off, UT just lofts it inside over over extra cover. No one in the deep and he picks up another boundary to his name.
FOUR! Nailed it! A quicker one around middle and leg, Tharanga makes a long stride forward and sweeps it behind square on the leg side. That raced away to the fence!
Tahir changes the angle and bowls a loopy leg break around middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Full outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Tossed up around middle and off, Weerakkody pushes it back to Tahir.
Nips back in from around off, Upul hangs back in defense. Lovely over from Parnell, just 3 and a wicket off it!
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

Good stop, Pretorious! A length ball in the channel outside off, Tharanga just tries to use the pace on it as he guides it towards short third man. Dwaine stationed there dives to his right and stops a certain boundary. A single taken!
Fuller in length and angling in, Weerakkody brings his bat down to defend but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Sandun Weerakkody comes out to replace Kusal Mendis at the centre.

OUT! Parnell strikes! Kusal Mendis has to walk back and that's a crucial breakthrough for the Proteas. Wayne Parnell comes steaming in and doles out a short ball on the leg stump, Mendis shuffles a bit to pull it on its way down to fine leg but the bounce gets the better of the batsman. He gets a bit of glove on it and de Kock behind the stumps takes a regulation catch. They appeal and the umpire has no hesitation in ruling it out. End of a good stand as the duo was looking to take the game away from the hosts. Sri Lanka need 165 from 136 balls!
A length ball outside off, Mendis pushes it on the up towards mid off. There was always a single but they don't take it.
A loud shout for LBW, not given! Tahir sends it quicker through the air around middle and leg, Tharanga looks to pull but misses and is hit on the pads. Seemed like the height was an issue there.
Around middle and off, milked down to long on for a single.
Floated ball around middle and off, Mendis bunts it back to the bowler.
A loopy full ball, dipping in around middle, UT sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Short and outside off, Mendis places it towards the short third man. Tharanga wanted the single and gets it comfortably in the end.
Loopy ball, skidding through the surface. Mendis initially looks to sweep it away on the leg side but then had to defend it down at the last moment.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

A length ball on middle, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single. My colleague brought an important point to me. Sri Lanka failed to even reach the 200-run mark in the previous 3 ODIs but today they have done that within 26 overs, achievement in itself!
A length ball on middle, Upul swivels a touch and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Tharanga stands tall and defends it towards the cover fielder.
On the pads, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Good length ball, coming in with the angle, Tharnaga looks to flick but gets it off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Wayne Parnell comes back into the attack.
Pushed through the air around off, pushed towards extra cover for a single. Tahir now has figures of - 4-0-38-0!
A touch short and around middle, tapped in front of the short mid-wicket fielder for a brisk single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Tahir comes from around the wicket now and bowls a quicker one around middle, it's punched down to long on for a single.
Gets down and across to paddle it fine down the leg side for a couple.
In the air... but safe!!! A low full toss around off, Kusal gets down and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. It goes on the bounce to the fielder, just a single taken.
Goes for the cut shot but fails to get any bat on it. 14 off the over!
Upul Tharanga slams his 14th ODI century off 73 balls. He also brings up the 50-run stand between him and Kusal Mendis.

SIX! Wastes no time! What a knock from the skipper! He brings up his ton in style. I remember, he said in the post-match presentation during the 3rd ODI that they would focus more on batting and look he has set an example here tonight. A nicely tossed up ball around middle, Tharanga hoicks it cleanly down the ground over long on for a maximum. Mendis hugs him and pats his back as well. Can he convert this into a daddy hundred?
Short and quicker outside off, cut behind point for a couple.

SIX! Into the 90s now is Tharanga! Tossed up around off, gets down on one knee and nails the slog sweep over mid-wicket for a maximum all the way. He has cleared the fence every time he opted for that shot.

Beaten! Shamsi bowls a loopy ball around off, it turns away after pitching, Tharanga gets down and tries to go inside out but is beaten by the flight there. A good take by de Kock behind, not an easy one though.
Full around off, defended off the front foot by the Lankan skipper.
Shorter and flatter one around middle, tucked towards square leg for one.
UT has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on the pads, nudged towards the on side for a single.
FOUR! Half tracker and it's duly punished! Mendis rocks back and flays it with a punch through cover-point for a boundary. This should give him some confidence.
Comes half forward and defends it down gently.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call! The decision stays as it is! Tahir brings out a googly and Mendis comes forward to defend it down. Is beaten by this and is hit on the front pad. Tahir roars out a huge LBW appeal but the umpire turns it down. The leggie convinces his skipper to opt for the review and replays show it wasn't a bad one at all. It was pitched in line and would have gone on to clip the leg stump. Mendis survives a scare here!
A loud shout for LBW against Mendis is referred upstairs! Tahir feels he has got his man. Where is the impact? Let's wait and find out...
Imran Tahir comes back into the attack.
Shamsi is lucky to get away from it! A short ball outside off, Upul slaps hard but finds Parnell at backward point.

SIX! In the arc and out of the park! Gets a nice flighted ball around off, Tharanga senses an opportunity to go after it. He gets down on his rear knee and murders the slog sweep over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Fires it full and outside off, Tharanga tries to help it down to third man but gets it off the outer part of the bat towards short third man.
Flatter one around off, defended back to the bowler.
Pushed quicker through the air around middle, it's clipped towards square leg for one.
Floated ball around off, turning away, Tharanga pushes it towards backward point for a single.
Leg bye! Strays on the pads as Tharanga misses his flick and the ball rolls off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye stolen.
Fuller and on middle and leg, worked towards mid on for a single.

FOUR! Deliberately done! Behardien serves a length ball outside off, Mendis waits for the ball to come on the bat and then opens the face at the last moment. Shamsi at short third man dives to his left to stop but dives all over it.
Fuller around off, driven past covers for a couple.
In the air... safe! A length ball around off, Mendis lunges forward and lofts it over wide mid off. Duminy from long off comes quickly across to his left and does well to keep them down to a couple.
Short and outside off, Mendis camps back and cuts it hard but finds the man at short third man.
Farhaan Behardien is introduced into the attack!
Mendis makes this delivery a full toss as he sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Flighted delivery, spinning away, Tharanga guides it to short third man and steals a single.
Tharanga knocks it back to the bowler who makes a diving stop.
Floated delivery, Mendis drives it down to mid off for a single to bring up the 150-run mark for his team.
Quicker delivery, around off, Tharanga pushes it towards off side for a single.
Tossed up delivery, outside off, it spins away as Tharanga drives it to point fielder.
Good length, outside off, Mendis drives it straight to cover.
Length ball, outside off, Tharanga pushes it to cover region for a single.
Length ball, outside off, Mendis drives it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Mendis cuts it past the point fielder. The third man had no chance to cut it down. Brilliant stroke this!
Length delivery, angling in, Mendis hops and defends it from the crease.
Length ball, Mendis pats it to the point region.
Gets across and drives it down to long on for an easy single.
Pushed quicker through the air around middle, Mendis covers the line and defends.
Tosses it up around off, Mendis presses forward and blocks it down as the ball rolls back to the bowler.
Loopy full and around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Gets down and sweeps it towards short fine leg.
Tossed up around off, turning away, pushed towards the man at point.
Shorter ball, outside off, Mendis again taps it to point.
Back of a length ball, Mendis pushes it to point from the crease.
Full ball, outside off, Mendis drives it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery, Tharanga flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Tharanga nudges it to backward square leg.
Kusal Mendis walks in next, replacing Dikcwella!

OUT! Dickwella dances down the track, as Pretorius follows him and the southpaw top edges it to Behardien,who catches it rather unconvincingly, at deep mid-wicket. South Africa draw first blood. And this magnificent partnership comes to an end.
Flatter delivery, outside off, Tharanga cuts it to backward point.
Dickwella drives this tossed up delivery through mid off. One run added to the total.
Works it around mid-wicket for no run.
Dickwella wants to sweep but gets a top edge which hits him on the helmet.

That's off the keeper's gloves! A quicker one around off, spinning away a bit, Tharanga plays it extremely late as he looks to cut it late. The ball goes off de Kock's gloves and runs down towards short third man where Amla dives to his right to stop that one. A single taken but surely a chance goes down abegging.
Tossed up delivery, outside off,  Tharanga drives it to covers.
FOUR! Beautiful! A length ball outside off, Dickwella just upper cuts it over the keeper to score another boundary.
Tharanga dabs this length delivery to third man and runs one.
Fuller ball, Tharanga defends it towards covers.
Short delivery, Dickwella pulls it to deep mid-wicket and brings Tharanga back on strike.
Length ball, around off, Dickwella wants to scoop but doesn't get the direction he was expecting and then looks to loft it over keeper but misses.
3rd ODI fifty for Niroshan Dickwella!

FOUR! Short of a length delivery, Dickwella moves back and cuts it past the point fielder. Lovely timing, there! Tahir at third man gave it a chase but was too slow to catch up to it. Back-to-back fifties for Dickwella.
FOUR! Short and punished, Tharanga pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary and is looking set for a big score now.
Tossed up delivery, spins away, Tharanga looks to defend but gets the outside edge towards the off side.
Full delivery, Dickwella drives it to long on to bring Tharanga back on strike.
Fullish delivery, on middle, Dickwella again paddle sweeps it towards fine leg for a couple.
Tossed up, Dickwella dances down the track but eventually defends it to mid-wicket as Shamsi followed him.
Full delivery, on middle, Dickwella paddle sweeps it fine and picks up a brace.
Tabraiz Shamsi is introduced into the attack now!
Short delivery, Dickwella pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Dickwella dances down the ground, but Pretorius responds with a bouncer making the southpaw pull out of a premeditated stroke.
Tharanga drives this full length ball to mid off and steals a quick single.
Similar delivery, outside off, Tharanga gets beaten again attempting a similar shot. Has a word with Dickwella, who must be asking him to calm down.
Good length ball,  outside off, Tharanga wants to help it to third man but misses.
Back of a length ball, Dickwella guides it to third man for an easy single.
Rabada ends the over with a bouncer, Tharanga leaves it alone.
Short ball, Dickwella pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Top, top shot. Full length ball outside off, Dickwella opens the face of the bat, uses the pace and punches it through cover. The sweeper cover fielder was there in place but could do nothing about it.
Length ball, angling in, Dickwella looks to loft it over mid on, but doesn't quite connect as the fielder from mid on gives it a chase to save some runs for his team.
Length ball, around off, Dickwella opens the face of the bat and pushes it to Duminy at point.
Good length, outside off, Tharanga drives it to sweeper cover and runs one.
FOUR! Tharanga opens the face of the bat and steers it past the point fielder for a boundary. Imran Tahir comes running in, puts in a dive but fails to stop it from crossing the rope.
Length ball, Tharanga pushes it to covers and sets off for a quick single. The cover fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end, but doesn't hit the stumps.
Half volley, Tharanga drives it down the ground, but Pretorius makes a stop in his followthrough.
Good length ball, around leg, Dickwella flicks it in front of square for a single.
Back of a length ball, it bounces as Dickwella defends it from the crease.
Good length delivery, outside off, Tharanga dabs it to third man for a single.
Dwaine Pretorius comes back into the attack.
Angles it on the pads, worked away towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Fires in a yorker on the stumps, Dickwella jams it out well.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Good length ball on the pads, Tharanga flicks it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Hits the deck hard, Tharanga sits under the bumper.
Short and outside off, glided behind point for a single.
FOUR! Just before this ball the fielder from mid off was dropped back but Tahir serves it on the pads. Upul once again goes for a whip shot over square leg for a boundary. 13 off the over!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Classy batting! Tahir gives this one a truck loaded with flight and Tharanga just hammers it over extra cover. Made good use connection again!
Fuller and around middle and leg, Tharanga looks to flick but maybe it went off the inner part of the bat towards short fine leg.
FOUR! Whip! Floats it up around middle and leg, Tharanga whips it beautifully over square leg for a one bounce boundary.
Short and around off, Dickwella looks to cut it awya on the off side but gets an outside edge which falls just short of the fielder at short third man. A single taken.
Fuller and curling back in, pushed towards mid on.
Angles it in from around off, defended back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Niroshan hangs back to defend but gets an outside edge past first slip to third man for a single.
Upul Tharanga brings up his 31st ODI fifty off 24 balls!

A length ball outside off, Tharanga taps it towards backward point and scampers across for a single. A superb start from him! Captain is leading from the front, he got a start in the last game as well but couldn't capitalize on it. Can he make the most if it today?
Gets behind the line and defends it towards the off side.

FOUR LEG BYES! Rabada tries to angle it on the pads but goes too straight this time. Tharanga looks to clip it fine down the leg side but the ball brushes his pads and races down to the fine leg fence.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Quicker through the air around off, pushed towards extra cover for a brisk single.
SIX! Slogged! Tahir gives this one a bit more flight around middle and leg, it's in the slot for Tharnaga. He sits down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for half a dozen!
FOUR! Lovely shot! Floats it up around middle and off, Tharanga stands tall and smacks it over extra cover. A couple of bounces and into the fence she goes.
Around middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Tharanga defends it towards the leg side for a single.
Imran Tahir into the attack now, replacing Parnell!

FOUR! Low full toss and Dickwella takes full toll of it! He makes room and lifts it neatly over extra cover. AB de Villiers gives it a chase but could only burn some calories. 8 from Rabada's first over. Runs coming thick and fast for the Islanders here!
A length ball, angling down the leg side, Dickwella moves inside the line to clip but fails to get any bat on it. De Kock appeals for a catch but nothing from the umpire. A dot ball!
FOUR! Booming drive! Pitches it up but goes too full this time. Dickwella is up for it as he cracks one through covers. Beats the dive of the fielder there and crosses the fence in no time.
On a length and angling across this time, ND looks to poke at but is beaten all ends up.
Fuller and strayed on the pads, Niroshan misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side.
Starts with a length ball around middle and off, Dickwella defends it with a full face of the bat.
Kagiso Rabada into the attack now!

SIX! Pummeled! Back of a length ball, sitting up at a nice height too as Upul opts for the pull. Oh! That made a good rhyme too. But more than that he made terrific connection to send it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 16 off the over, another big one!
Another full ball on off, driven towards mid off for a single. 50 up for SL inside 5 overs!
Landed outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.

FOUR! Creamed! Serves a fuller length delivery in the channel outside off, Upul lunges forward and drives it ever so beautifully to pierce the gap through covers. Another boundary for the Sri Lankan skipper.
FOUR! Deliberately played! Short of a length delivery outside off, rising off the deck. Tharanga stays put, arches back and plays a ramp shot down to third man for a boundary.
Fuller and strayed on the pads, Tharanga looks to flick but the ball brushes his pads and rolls back to the keeper.
Leg bye! Duminy fires it on the pads, Tharanga looks to flick but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye taken. 13 off the over!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

SIX! Excellent shot, more than that brilliant use of the feet! Floats it up around off, Tharanga makes full toll of the field restrictions as goes inside out over extra cover and clears the fence with utmost ease. Back-to-back biggies for the Lankan skipper!

SIX! Flush on the rope! Duminy bowls a loopy delivery around middle, Tharanga skips down the track and smacks it over mid on. It's high and lands flush on the boundary rope. They check if the ball has bounced but it didn't.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Upul comes forward and defends it down gently.
Floats it up around off, Tharanga looks to drive but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Interesting move! JP Duminy to roll his arm over now!
Tharanga steers this back of a length delivery between short third man and point to run one.
Bowls this one down the leg side, Dickwella flicks it to fine leg for an easy single.
WOW! Outstanding delivery this, length ball, Dickwella wanted to push it towards off side, but got beaten by the swing.
FOUR! Good length delivery, on pads, Dickwella flicks it through mid-wicket to pick up a boundary. The chase by Pretorius from mid on was too poor and he couldn't even get close to the ball.

WIDE! Bowls this one down the leg side, Parnell thought it rapped Dickwella's pads, the umpire however thinks otherwise. Dickwella is looking to play the inside-out drive, that's the reason Parnell's looking to follow him.
Length ball, angling in, Dickwella moves across and drives it to covers.
Good length delivery, Tharanga flicks it through square leg for a single.
Dickwella flicks it off his pads.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, outside off, Dickwella square cuts it past the point fielder. Rabada, from third man, tried to stop it with a dive, but it beat him easily.
Dickwella goes for the pull and misses this short ball which was angling away.
Length ball, Dickwella cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
FOUR! Width and short. Dickwella stands and delivers, just slaps it past the point fielder to bring up his first boundary of the innings.
Good length delivery, outside off, Dickwella drives, but the bat moves as he goes for the shot, and beats the cover fielder as they pick up a brace.

Dwaine Pretorius will bowl from the other end with the second new ball. It has gotten really overcast there in the middle. There is plenty of breeze picking up though and hopefully the rain clouds will be blown away.
Good length delivery, on the sticks, Tharanga defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Back of a length ball, around middle, Tharanga is looking in good touch. Pulls it in front of square for another boundary.
Length ball, Tharanga defends it well within from the crease.
Short of a length, around off, Tharanga defends it to point.
FOUR! Supreme shot, pure timing. Full delivery, on the pads, Tharanga flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery, around off, Dickwella dabs it to third man to score the first runs for his team.

The players are out in the middle for the chase. Niroshan Dickwella and Upul Tharanga will open with the bat for Sri Lanka. Wayne Parnell will begin the proceedings with the ball for South Africa. Are we up for something special?
